name: Natural System of Wrangel Island Reserve
story: Natural System of Wrangel Island Reserve is in Chukotka, Russia, with an area of 7,600 km2. It is roughly the size of Crete and features a central belt of low-relief mountains. The island was home to the last surviving population of woolly mammoths.
matters: It serves as a vital breeding ground for polar bears with the highest density of dens in the world. The reserve also protects diverse Arctic plants and numerous seabird colonies.
